units.locator: Article 32.1. Enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty in the form of a warning
units.text: A ruling imposing an administrative penalty in the form of a warning shall be enforced by the judge, body or official that issued it by serving or sending a copy of the ruling in accordance with Article 29.11 of this Code.
units.label: Art. 32.1 · text

units.locator: Article 32.2. Enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative fine
units.text: Article 32.2. Enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative fine
units.label: Art. 32.2

units.locator: Article 32.2. Enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative fine
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 32.2. Enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative fine
units.label: Art. 32.2

units.locator: Article 32.2. Enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative fine
units.text: 1. An administrative fine must be paid in full by the person held administratively liable no later than sixty days from the day the ruling imposing the administrative fine enters into legal force, except in the cases specified in parts 1.1, 1.3 - 1.3-3 and 1.4 of this article, or from the day the deferral or instalment period specified in Article 31.5 of this Code expires. An administrative fine imposed for an administrative offence specified in chapter 16 or Article 19.7.13 of this Code may also be paid by another individual or legal entity.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 32.2

units.locator: Article 32.2. Enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative fine
units.text: 1.1. An administrative fine imposed on a foreign citizen or stateless person together with administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation must be paid no later than the day following the day the relevant ruling in the administrative offence case enters into legal force.
units.label: Part 1.1 Art. 32.2

units.locator: Article 32.2. Enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative fine
units.text: 1.2. An administrative fine imposed for an administrative offence specified in Article 11.23, 11.26, 11.27 or 11.29 or chapter 12 of this Code committed using a vehicle registered in a foreign state, or in part 1 of Article 20.25 of this Code (insofar as it concerns failure to pay an administrative fine imposed for an administrative offence specified in Article 11.23, 11.26, 11.27 or 11.29 or chapter 12 of this Code committed using a vehicle registered in a foreign state), must be paid before that vehicle leaves the territory of the Russian Federation, but no later than the time limit specified in part 1 of this article.
units.label: Part 1.2 Art. 32.2

units.locator: Article 32.2. Enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative fine
units.text: 1.3. Where a person held administratively liable for an administrative offence specified in chapter 12 of this Code, except the administrative offences specified in part 1.1 of Article 12.1, parts 2 and 4 of Article 12.7, Article 12.8, parts 6 and 7 of Article 12.9, Article 12.10, part 3 of Article 12.12, part 5 of Article 12.15, part 3.1 of Article 12.16, parts 4 - 6 of Article 12.23, Articles 12.24 and 12.26 and part 3 of Article 12.27 of this Code, or for an administrative offence specified by a law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation consisting of failure to comply with the procedure for paying for vehicle travel on toll public roads of regional, intermunicipal or local significance, private public roads, toll sections of public roads of regional, intermunicipal or local significance or private public roads, pays the administrative fine no later than thirty days from the day the ruling imposing it is issued, the fine may be paid at 75 per cent of the amount imposed. If a copy of the ruling imposing the administrative fine sent by registered post to the person held administratively liable arrives at that person’s address after thirty days have elapsed from the day the ruling was issued, that time limit shall be restored by the judge, body or official that issued the ruling upon an application by the person held administratively liable. A procedural order rejecting that application may be appealed against under the rules established by chapter 30 of this Code. If enforcement of the ruling imposing the administrative fine has been deferred or payment in instalments has been permitted by the judge, body or official that issued it, the administrative fine shall be paid in full.
units.label: Part 1.3 Art. 32.2

units.locator: Article 32.2. Enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative fine
units.text: 1.3-1. Where an administrative fine for an administrative offence specified in Articles 5.53 - 5.55, parts 10 and 14 of Article 7.30.3, parts 1, 3 and 4 of Article 13.25, part 1 of Article 14.4.1, parts 1 - 5 and 7 - 9 of Article 14.24, Articles 14.29, 14.30 and 14.36, parts 1 - 3 of Article 14.52 (in respect of self-regulatory organisations in the financial market), Articles 14.52.2, 15.17 - 15.20, 15.22, 15.23.1, 15.24.1 and 15.26, parts 2 - 4 and 6 of Article 15.26.1, Articles 15.26.2 - 15.26.5, 15.28, 15.29, 15.31, 15.34.1, 15.35, 15.36, 15.38 and 15.39, part 9 of Article 19.5 and Article 19.7.3 of this Code is paid by the person held administratively liable for that administrative offence or by another individual or legal entity no later than twenty days from the day the ruling imposing the fine is issued, the fine may be paid at half the amount imposed. If a copy of the ruling imposing the administrative fine sent by registered post to the person held administratively liable arrives at that person’s address after twenty days have elapsed from the day the ruling was issued, that time limit shall be restored by the judge, body or official that issued the ruling upon an application by the person held administratively liable. A procedural order rejecting that application may be appealed against under the rules established by chapter 30 of this Code. If enforcement of the ruling imposing the administrative fine has been deferred or payment in instalments has been permitted by the judge, body or official that issued it, the administrative fine shall be paid in full.
units.label: Part 1.3-1 Art. 32.2

units.locator: Article 32.2. Enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative fine
units.text: 1.3-2. Where a legal entity that is a small or medium-sized enterprise and has been held administratively liable for an administrative offence specified in parts 1 - 4 of Article 14.32 of this Code pays the administrative fine no later than twenty days from the day the ruling imposing it is issued, the fine may be paid at half the amount imposed. If a copy of the ruling imposing the administrative fine sent by registered post to the legal entity held administratively liable arrives at its address after twenty days have elapsed from the day the ruling was issued, that time limit shall be restored by the judge, body or official that issued the ruling upon an application by the legal entity held administratively liable. A procedural order rejecting that application may be appealed against under the rules established by chapter 30 of this Code. If enforcement of the ruling imposing the administrative fine has been deferred or payment in instalments has been permitted by the judge, body or official that issued it, the administrative fine shall be paid in full.
units.label: Part 1.3-2 Art. 32.2

units.locator: Article 32.2. Enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative fine
units.text: 1.3-3. Where an administrative fine for an administrative offence detected during state control (supervision) or municipal control is paid by the person held administratively liable for that administrative offence or by another individual or legal entity no later than twenty days from the day the ruling imposing the fine is issued, the fine may be paid at half the amount imposed, except for administrative offences specified in Articles 13.4, 13.11, 13.15, 13.29, 13.29.4, 13.37, 14.31 and 14.31.2, parts 5 - 7 of Article 14.32, Articles 14.33, 14.56, 15.21, 15.30 and 19.3, parts 1 - 5, 6 - 8.1 and 9.1 - 39 of Article 19.5, Articles 19.5.1, 19.6, 19.8 - 19.8.2 and 19.23, parts 2 and 3 of Article 19.27, Articles 19.28, 19.29, 19.30, 19.33, 19.34 and 20.3 and part 2 of Article 20.28 of this Code. If a copy of the ruling imposing the administrative fine sent by registered post to the person held administratively liable arrives at that person’s address after twenty days have elapsed from the day the ruling was issued, that time limit shall be restored by the judge, body or official that issued the ruling upon an application by the person held administratively liable. A procedural order rejecting that application may be appealed against under the rules established by chapter 30 of this Code. If enforcement of the ruling imposing the administrative fine has been deferred or payment in instalments has been permitted by the judge, body or official that issued it, the administrative fine shall be paid in full.
units.label: Part 1.3-3 Art. 32.2

units.locator: Article 32.2. Enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative fine
units.text: 1.4. An administrative fine imposed for an administrative offence specified in Article 15.27.3 or 19.28 of this Code must be paid no later than seven days from the day the ruling imposing the administrative fine enters into legal force.
units.label: Part 1.4 Art. 32.2

units.locator: Article 32.2. Enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative fine
units.text: 1.5. An administrative fine specified in parts 1 - 1.4 of this article may be paid in the corresponding amount before the day the ruling imposing the administrative fine enters into legal force by the person held administratively liable, and, for an administrative offence specified in chapter 16 or Article 19.7.13 of this Code or part 1.3-1 or 1.3-3 of this article, also by another individual or legal entity.
units.label: Part 1.5 Art. 32.2

units.locator: Article 32.2. Enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative fine
units.text: 2. If a minor has no independent earnings, the administrative fine shall be recovered from the minor’s parents or other statutory representatives.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 32.2

units.locator: Article 32.2. Enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative fine
units.text: 3. The amount of an administrative fine shall be deposited or transferred by the person held administratively liable or by another individual or legal entity to a credit institution, including through a bank payment agent or bank payment subagent operating in accordance with the Federal Law “On the National Payment System”, to a federal postal service organisation, or to a payment agent operating in accordance with Federal Law of 3 June 2009 No. 103-FZ “On Activities for Accepting Payments from Individuals Carried Out by Payment Agents”.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 32.2

units.locator: Article 32.2. Enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative fine
units.text: 4. Repealed with effect from 1 January 2008. - Federal Law of 24.07.2007 No. 210-FZ.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 32.2

units.locator: Article 32.2. Enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative fine
units.text: 5. If, after expiry of the time limit specified in part 1, 1.1 or 1.4 of this article, there is no document evidencing payment of the administrative fine and no information on its payment in the State Information System on State and Municipal Payments, the judge, body or official that issued the ruling shall produce a second copy and send it within ten days, or within one day in the cases specified in parts 1.1 and 1.4 of this article, to a bailiff for enforcement in accordance with the procedure specified by federal legislation. If the second copy of the ruling imposing the administrative fine is produced as an electronic document whose legal validity is confirmed by an enhanced qualified electronic signature in accordance with the legislation of the Russian Federation, that second copy shall be sent electronically to the bailiff over information and telecommunications networks. In addition, an official of the federal executive body, structural subdivision or territorial body, or other state body that considered the administrative offence case, or an authorised person of the collegiate body that considered the case, shall draw up a record of the administrative offence specified in part 1 of Article 20.25 of this Code against the person who failed to pay the administrative fine. A record of the administrative offence specified in part 1 of Article 20.25 of this Code against a person who failed to pay an administrative fine in an administrative offence case considered by a judge shall be drawn up by a bailiff. No record of the administrative offence specified in part 1 of Article 20.25 of this Code shall be drawn up in the case specified in note 1 to Article 20.25 of this Code.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 32.2

units.locator: Article 32.2. Enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative fine
units.text: Parts six - seven have been repealed. - Federal Law of 08.12.2003 No. 161-FZ.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 32.2 · “Parts six - seven have been repealed. - Federal Law of…”

units.locator: Article 32.2. Enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative fine
units.text: 8. A bank or other credit institution, a federal postal service organisation, a payment agent accepting payments from individuals, or a bank payment agent (subagent) operating in accordance with the Federal Law “On the National Payment System”, to which the amount of an administrative fine is paid, must send information on payment of the fine to the State Information System on State and Municipal Payments in accordance with the procedure and within the time limits specified by Federal Law of 27 July 2010 No. 210-FZ “On the Organisation of the Provision of State and Municipal Services”.
units.label: Part 8 Art. 32.2

units.locator: Article 32.4. Enforcement of a ruling confiscating an item that was the instrument used to commit or the object of an administrative offence
units.text: Article 32.4. Enforcement of a ruling confiscating an item that was the instrument used to commit or the object of an administrative offence
units.label: Art. 32.4

units.locator: Article 32.4. Enforcement of a ruling confiscating an item that was the instrument used to commit or the object of an administrative offence
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 32.4. Enforcement of a ruling confiscating an item that was the instrument used to commit or the object of an administrative offence
units.label: Art. 32.4

units.locator: Article 32.4. Enforcement of a ruling confiscating an item that was the instrument used to commit or the object of an administrative offence
units.text: 1. A judge’s ruling confiscating an item that was the instrument used to commit or the object of an administrative offence shall be enforced by a bailiff in accordance with the procedure specified by federal legislation; a ruling confiscating weapons and ammunition shall be enforced by the territorial bodies of the federal executive body performing functions in the sphere of the activities of the National Guard Troops of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 32.4

units.locator: Article 32.4. Enforcement of a ruling confiscating an item that was the instrument used to commit or the object of an administrative offence
units.text: 1.1. A judge’s ruling confiscating an item that was the instrument used to commit or the object of an administrative offence for which liability is established by Article 14.10 or chapter 16 of this Code shall be enforced by the customs body that seized the item, by transferring it to the body (organisation) authorised by the Government of the Russian Federation to dispose of goods that have become federal property, in accordance with the procedure established by the Government of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 1.1 Art. 32.4

units.locator: Article 32.4. Enforcement of a ruling confiscating an item that was the instrument used to commit or the object of an administrative offence
units.text: 2. Confiscated items that were instruments used to commit or objects of an administrative offence shall be sold in accordance with the procedure established by the Government of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 32.4

units.locator: Article 32.4. Enforcement of a ruling confiscating an item that was the instrument used to commit or the object of an administrative offence
units.text: 3. Confiscated copies of works and phonograms, materials and equipment used to reproduce them, and other instruments used to commit the administrative offence specified in part 1 of Article 7.12 of this Code shall be destroyed, except where confiscated copies of works or phonograms are transferred to the copyright or related rights holder at that holder’s request. If those instruments or objects were seized in accordance with Article 27.10 of this Code or attached in accordance with Article 27.14 of this Code, their destruction or transfer shall be carried out by the judge or, on the judge’s instructions, by the body whose official carried out the seizure or attachment.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 32.4

units.locator: Article 32.4. Enforcement of a ruling confiscating an item that was the instrument used to commit or the object of an administrative offence
units.text: 3.1. If weapons or ammunition were seized in accordance with Article 27.10 of this Code or attached in accordance with Article 27.14 of this Code, they shall be transferred to the territorial body of the federal executive body performing functions in the sphere of the activities of the National Guard Troops of the Russian Federation, on the judge’s instructions, by the body whose official carried out the seizure or attachment. Confiscated weapons and (or) ammunition for them shall be destroyed in accordance with the weapons legislation of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 3.1 Art. 32.4

units.locator: Article 32.4. Enforcement of a ruling confiscating an item that was the instrument used to commit or the object of an administrative offence
units.text: 4. Confiscated light industry goods on a list established by the Government of the Russian Federation shall be destroyed in accordance with the procedure established by the Government of the Russian Federation, except for their transfer free of charge in cases where the legislation of the Russian Federation allows such transfer, and their transfer free of charge to the federal executive body authorised in the field of defence, or for emergency humanitarian response measures to the federal executive body authorised to address tasks concerning protection of the population and territories from emergencies, in the cases and in accordance with the procedure established by the Government of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 32.4

units.locator: Article 32.4. Enforcement of a ruling confiscating an item that was the instrument used to commit or the object of an administrative offence
units.text: 4.1. Confiscated property that was the instrument used to commit or the object of an administrative offence, on a list approved by the Government of the Russian Federation, shall become the property of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation in which it is located, except for property subject to confiscation under Article 14.10 or chapter 16 of this Code. The procedure for disposal of property becoming the property of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation shall be determined by that entity’s highest executive body.
units.label: Part 4.1 Art. 32.4

units.locator: Article 32.4. Enforcement of a ruling confiscating an item that was the instrument used to commit or the object of an administrative offence
units.text: 5. Confiscated gaming equipment used for the unlawful organisation or conduct of gambling, confiscated devices preventing identification of state registration plates or enabling them to be altered or concealed, and instruments used to commit the administrative offence specified in part 1 of Article 14.27 of this Code shall be destroyed in accordance with the procedure established by the Government of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 32.4

units.locator: Article 32.4. Enforcement of a ruling confiscating an item that was the instrument used to commit or the object of an administrative offence
units.text: 6. Confiscated goods and products subject to labelling and (or) information-marking requirements established by the legislation of the Russian Federation that were instruments used to commit or objects of administrative offences specified in Article 15.12 of this Code (except for alcohol-containing medicinal products for medical use, alcohol-containing perfumery and cosmetic products, alcoholic products, tobacco products, nicotine-containing products, food products and light industry goods disposed of in accordance with the procedure established by the legislation of the Russian Federation) shall, in the cases and in accordance with the procedure for disposal of property that has become state property established by the Government of the Russian Federation, be sent for processing (recycling) or destruction, or may be transferred free of charge, in the cases and in accordance with the procedure established by the Government of the Russian Federation, to federal executive bodies and (or) organisations designated by the Government of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 32.4

units.locator: Article 32.5. Bodies enforcing rulings depriving a person of a special right
units.text: Article 32.5. Bodies enforcing rulings depriving a person of a special right
units.label: Art. 32.5

units.locator: Article 32.5. Bodies enforcing rulings depriving a person of a special right
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 32.5. Bodies enforcing rulings depriving a person of a special right
units.label: Art. 32.5

units.locator: Article 32.5. Bodies enforcing rulings depriving a person of a special right
units.text: 1. A judge’s ruling depriving a person of the right to drive a vehicle, other than a tractor, self-propelled machine or other types of machinery, shall be enforced by officials of internal affairs bodies.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 32.5

units.locator: Article 32.5. Bodies enforcing rulings depriving a person of a special right
units.text: 2. A judge’s ruling depriving a person of the right to operate a tractor, self-propelled machine or other types of machinery shall be enforced by officials of bodies exercising regional state supervision over the technical condition of self-propelled machines and other types of machinery.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 32.5

units.locator: Article 32.5. Bodies enforcing rulings depriving a person of a special right
units.text: 3. A judge’s ruling depriving a person of the right to operate a vessel (including a small vessel) shall be enforced by officials of bodies exercising state supervision over compliance with the rules for the use of vessels (including small vessels).
units.label: Part 3 Art. 32.5

units.locator: Article 32.5. Bodies enforcing rulings depriving a person of a special right
units.text: 4. A judge’s ruling depriving a person of the right to operate radio-electronic equipment or high-frequency devices shall be enforced by officials of bodies exercising state supervision over communications.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 32.5

units.locator: Article 32.5. Bodies enforcing rulings depriving a person of a special right
units.text: 5. A judge’s ruling depriving a person of the right to hunt shall be enforced by officials of bodies exercising federal state supervision over the protection, reproduction and use of wildlife classified as hunting resources and their habitats.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 32.5

units.locator: Article 32.5. Bodies enforcing rulings depriving a person of a special right
units.text: 6. A judge’s ruling depriving a person of the right to acquire and store, or store and carry, weapons and ammunition for them shall be enforced by officials of the territorial bodies of the federal executive body performing functions in the sphere of the activities of the National Guard Troops of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 32.5

units.locator: Article 32.6. Procedure for enforcing a ruling depriving a person of a special right
units.text: Article 32.6. Procedure for enforcing a ruling depriving a person of a special right
units.label: Art. 32.6

units.locator: Article 32.6. Procedure for enforcing a ruling depriving a person of a special right
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 32.6. Procedure for enforcing a ruling depriving a person of a special right
units.label: Art. 32.6

units.locator: Article 32.6. Procedure for enforcing a ruling depriving a person of a special right
units.text: 1. A ruling depriving a person of the right to drive the relevant type of vehicle or operate other types of machinery shall be enforced by withdrawing and retaining, for the duration of deprivation of that special right, the driving licence, licence to operate vessels (including small vessels) or tractor driver-operator’s (tractor driver’s) certificate, respectively, if the driver, vessel operator or tractor driver-operator (tractor driver) has been deprived of the right to drive or operate all types of vehicles, vessels (including small vessels) and other machinery.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 32.6

units.locator: Article 32.6. Procedure for enforcing a ruling depriving a person of a special right
units.text: 2. A ruling depriving a person of the right to operate radio-electronic equipment or high-frequency devices shall be enforced by withdrawing and retaining the special permit to operate such equipment or devices for the duration of deprivation of that special right. The procedure for withdrawing the special permit to operate radio-electronic equipment or high-frequency devices shall be established by the federal executive body exercising state supervision over communications in the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 32.6

units.locator: Article 32.6. Procedure for enforcing a ruling depriving a person of a special right
units.text: 3. A ruling depriving a person of the right to hunt shall be enforced by cancelling the hunting permit.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 32.6

units.locator: Article 32.6. Procedure for enforcing a ruling depriving a person of a special right
units.text: 3.1. A ruling depriving a person of the right to acquire and store, or store and carry, weapons and ammunition for them shall be enforced by cancelling the licence to acquire weapons and (or) the permit to store, or store and carry, weapons and ammunition for them, and by seizing the weapons and ammunition.
units.label: Part 3.1 Art. 32.6

units.locator: Article 32.6. Procedure for enforcing a ruling depriving a person of a special right
units.text: 4. Upon expiry of the period of deprivation of a special right, documents withdrawn from the person subjected to that type of administrative penalty shall be returned, except in the cases specified in part 4.1 of this article and Article 32.6.1 of this Code.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 32.6

units.locator: Article 32.6. Procedure for enforcing a ruling depriving a person of a special right
units.text: 4.1. Upon expiry of the period of deprivation of a special right for administrative offences specified in Article 9.3 and chapter 12 of this Code, the driving licence or tractor driver-operator’s (tractor driver’s) certificate withdrawn from the person subjected to that type of administrative penalty shall be returned after that person’s knowledge of the Road Traffic Rules has been tested and the administrative fines imposed on that person for road traffic offences have been paid in accordance with the established procedure; for administrative offences specified in part 1 of Article 12.8, part 1 of Article 12.26 and part 3 of Article 12.27 of this Code, a medical examination of that person for medical contraindications to driving a vehicle shall also be required, except in the cases specified in Article 32.6.1 of this Code.
units.label: Part 4.1 Art. 32.6

units.locator: Article 32.6. Procedure for enforcing a ruling depriving a person of a special right
units.text: 5. Unclaimed documents shall be retained for three years. Upon expiry of that period, unclaimed documents shall be destroyed.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 32.6

units.locator: Article 32.6.1. Procedure for enforcing a ruling depriving a person of the right to drive the relevant type of vehicle or operate other types of machinery during mobilisation, martial law or wartime
units.text: Article 32.6.1. Procedure for enforcing a ruling depriving a person of the right to drive the relevant type of vehicle or operate other types of machinery during mobilisation, martial law or wartime
units.label: Art. 32.6.1

units.locator: Article 32.6.1. Procedure for enforcing a ruling depriving a person of the right to drive the relevant type of vehicle or operate other types of machinery during mobilisation, martial law or wartime
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 32.6.1. Procedure for enforcing a ruling depriving a person of the right to drive the relevant type of vehicle or operate other types of machinery during mobilisation, martial law or wartime
units.label: Art. 32.6.1

units.locator: Article 32.6.1. Procedure for enforcing a ruling depriving a person of the right to drive the relevant type of vehicle or operate other types of machinery during mobilisation, martial law or wartime
units.text: 1. During mobilisation, martial law or wartime, enforcement of a ruling depriving a person of a special right for an administrative offence specified in Article 9.3 or chapter 12 of this Code shall be suspended if the person subjected to that type of administrative penalty is called up for military service upon mobilisation or during wartime, or concludes a military service contract or a contract to serve in a volunteer formation (to provide voluntary assistance in carrying out tasks assigned to the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation or the National Guard Troops of the Russian Federation) during mobilisation, martial law or wartime, and is engaged in carrying out tasks of the special military operation. The driving licence or tractor driver-operator’s (tractor driver’s) certificate shall be returned to that person; the period of deprivation of the special right shall not be interrupted.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 32.6.1

units.locator: Article 32.6.1. Procedure for enforcing a ruling depriving a person of the right to drive the relevant type of vehicle or operate other types of machinery during mobilisation, martial law or wartime
units.text: 2. Enforcement of the ruling depriving a person of the right to drive the relevant type of vehicle or operate other types of machinery shall resume from the day the person specified in part 1 of this article is discharged from military service or removed from the volunteer formation, except in the cases specified in parts 3 and 4 of this article.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 32.6.1

units.locator: Article 32.6.1. Procedure for enforcing a ruling depriving a person of the right to drive the relevant type of vehicle or operate other types of machinery during mobilisation, martial law or wartime
units.text: 3. If, while performing military service or serving in a volunteer formation, the person specified in part 1 of this article commits a new administrative offence specified in Article 9.3 or chapter 12 of this Code, enforcement of the ruling depriving that person of the right to drive the relevant type of vehicle or operate other types of machinery shall resume from the day a new ruling imposing the administrative penalty of deprivation of the relevant right enters into legal force.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 32.6.1

units.locator: Article 32.6.1. Procedure for enforcing a ruling depriving a person of the right to drive the relevant type of vehicle or operate other types of machinery during mobilisation, martial law or wartime
units.text: 4. Enforcement of a ruling depriving the person specified in part 1 of this article of a special right for an administrative offence specified in Article 9.3 or chapter 12 of this Code shall terminate, and the driving licence or tractor driver-operator’s (tractor driver’s) certificate withdrawn from that person shall be returned without the test of knowledge of the Road Traffic Rules and medical examination for medical contraindications to driving a vehicle specified in part 4.1 of Article 32.6 of this Code:
units.label: Part 4 Art. 32.6.1

units.locator: Article 32.6.1. Procedure for enforcing a ruling depriving a person of the right to drive the relevant type of vehicle or operate other types of machinery during mobilisation, martial law or wartime
units.text: 1) from the day the person receives a state award conferred during military service or service in a volunteer formation;
units.label: Point 1 Part 4 Art. 32.6.1

units.locator: Article 32.6.1. Procedure for enforcing a ruling depriving a person of the right to drive the relevant type of vehicle or operate other types of machinery during mobilisation, martial law or wartime
units.text: 2) from the day of discharge from military service on a ground specified in subpoint “а”, “в” or “г” of point 1 of Article 51 of Federal Law of 28 March 1998 No. 53-FZ “On Military Duty and Military Service”;

units.label: Point 3 Part 4 Art. 32.6.1

units.locator: Article 32.6.1. Procedure for enforcing a ruling depriving a person of the right to drive the relevant type of vehicle or operate other types of machinery during mobilisation, martial law or wartime
units.text: 5. Upon receipt from authorised bodies of information on the circumstances specified in part 4 of this article, a ruling terminating enforcement of the ruling depriving a person of the right to drive the relevant type of vehicle or operate other types of machinery shall be issued in compliance with the requirements specified in Article 31.7 of this Code.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 32.6.1

units.locator: Article 32.6.1. Procedure for enforcing a ruling depriving a person of the right to drive the relevant type of vehicle or operate other types of machinery during mobilisation, martial law or wartime
units.text: 6. The procedure for cooperation on matters concerning enforcement of a ruling depriving a person of the right to drive the relevant type of vehicle or operate other types of machinery and return of the driving licence or tractor driver-operator’s (tractor driver’s) certificate in respect of the person specified in part 1 of this article shall be determined by joint decisions of the federal executive body responsible for developing and implementing state policy and regulatory legal regulation in the field of defence, the federal executive body responsible for developing and implementing state policy and regulatory legal regulation in the sphere of the activities of the National Guard Troops of the Russian Federation, the federal executive body responsible for developing and implementing state policy and regulatory legal regulation in internal affairs, and the federal executive body responsible for developing and implementing state policy and regulatory legal regulation concerning the technical condition and operation of self-propelled machines and other types of machinery.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 32.6.1
